name: 📐 Grid-UI Widget Library
description:
Approved coordination, 2026-10-25: shared part/template work T517 moved intact from P052 to P067/F003, before T398. P052 retains only T118 structural variant cleanup, T122 delivered lint-alignment verification and T350 delivered flex API/docs/acceptance closeout. These residuals do not gate the shared API chain. Terminal-header ownership is P094/T450 and actual multi-document content tabs are P106/T550 after managed content T452; existing generic Pane/Tabs widgets do not prove those app capabilities. The library scope below remains the reusable primitive foundation.

Espansione della libreria UI GPU-free e signal-driven: scroll/list primitive, pane shell header/tabs, icon widget Nerd Font, showcase coverage con visual regression, bloom/custom draw effects, widget aggiuntivi e cleanup del crate.
